description: Overleaf MCP server for Claude, Codex, ChatGPT, and Cursor with safe LaTeX editing and review.
author: Zichao Yang

tool_signatures.name: accept_tracked_changes
tool_signatures.description: Accept suggestions in a document, so that suggested insertions become ordinary text and suggested deletions are removed for good.

tool_signatures.name: add_comment
tool_signatures.description: Start a review-panel comment thread on an exact snippet of text, with a first message, for raising a question without changing the prose.

quoteText.description: Exact text the comment should be anchored to, matched literally. Must occur exactly once in the document.

parameters.name: quoteText
parameters.description: Exact text the comment should be anchored to, matched literally. Must occur exactly once in the document.

tool_signatures.name: check_references
tool_signatures.description: Check a LaTeX document

tool_signatures.name: compile_on_overleaf
tool_signatures.description: Compile the project on Overleaf

draft.description: Draft mode: faster, with images replaced by boxes. Defaults to false.

stopOnFirstError.description: Stop at the first LaTeX error instead of carrying on to produce a PDF. Defaults to false, as in Overleaf.

savePdfTo.description: Absolute path to save the PDF to, ending in .pdf, in a directory that exists. Replaces an existing PDF there, never any other file.

parameters.name: draft
parameters.description: Draft mode: faster, with images replaced by boxes. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: savePdfTo
parameters.description: Absolute path to save the PDF to, ending in .pdf, in a directory that exists. Replaces an existing PDF there, never any other file.

parameters.name: stopOnFirstError
parameters.description: Stop at the first LaTeX error instead of carrying on to produce a PDF. Defaults to false, as in Overleaf.

tool_signatures.name: compile_project
tool_signatures.description: Compile one project locally with latexmk -pdf and report the errors and warnings, so a broken paper is caught before collaborators see it. Call it after editing and before push_changes.

mainTexFile.description: Path to the root .tex file, the one containing \\begin{document}. Omitted, the server guesses it from the project layout and says so if the guess has no document environment.

parameters.name: mainTexFile
parameters.description: Path to the root .tex file, the one containing \\begin{document}. Omitted, the server guesses it from the project layout and says so if the guess has no document environment.

tool_signatures.name: create_project
tool_signatures.description: Create a new project in the signed-in Overleaf account, either blank (a minimal main.tex) or from Overleaf

tool_signatures.name: delete_comment
tool_signatures.description: Delete a review-panel comment thread for everyone: its anchor in the document and every message in it.

tool_signatures.name: delete_file
tool_signatures.description: Delete a file from the project.

path.description: Path of the file to delete, relative to the project root, e.g. sections/old-draft.tex. Directories cannot be deleted, only files.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path of the file to delete, relative to the project root, e.g. sections/old-draft.tex. Directories cannot be deleted, only files.

tool_signatures.name: discard_local_changes
tool_signatures.description: Permanently throw away every local edit, new file and unpushed commit in one project

tool_signatures.name: download_project_zip
tool_signatures.description: Download the whole project from Overleaf as a ZIP archive, binary files included, as the editor

saveTo.description: Absolute path to save the archive to, ending in .zip, in a directory that exists. Replaces an existing ZIP there, never any other file.

parameters.name: saveTo
parameters.description: Absolute path to save the archive to, ending in .zip, in a directory that exists. Replaces an existing ZIP there, never any other file.

tool_signatures.name: edit_section
tool_signatures.description: Replace one whole section of a .tex file, located by its title. Use replace_text for a smaller change and this to rewrite a section wholesale.

path.description: Path to the .tex file relative to the project root.

sectionTitle.description: Title of the section to replace, as it appears in the sectioning command. Matched case-insensitively, with a substring fallback. Call list_sections if unsure.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path to the .tex file relative to the project root.

parameters.name: sectionTitle
parameters.description: Title of the section to replace, as it appears in the sectioning command. Matched case-insensitively, with a substring fallback. Call list_sections if unsure.

tool_signatures.name: list_account_projects
tool_signatures.description: List every project the signed-in Overleaf account can open, as the Overleaf dashboard does, with each one

nameContains.description: Only projects whose name contains this text, compared case-insensitively. Omit to list all.

parameters.name: nameContains
parameters.description: Only projects whose name contains this text, compared case-insensitively. Omit to list all.

tool_signatures.name: list_comments
tool_signatures.description: Read the review-panel comment threads in a project: which text each one is anchored to, whether it is open or resolved, and every message in it with author and time.

path.description: Only this document. Omit to read every document in the project.

includeResolved.description: Also list resolved threads. Defaults to false, which matches what the review panel shows first.

parameters.name: includeResolved
parameters.description: Also list resolved threads. Defaults to false, which matches what the review panel shows first.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Only this document. Omit to read every document in the project.

tool_signatures.name: list_files
tool_signatures.description: List every file in the project, grouped by kind (LaTeX sources, bibliographies, figures, other), after pulling the latest commits from Overleaf.

extension.description: Case-insensitive extension, e.g. tex or .bib; omitted lists all kinds.

includeUntracked.description: Also list files created locally and not yet pushed to Overleaf, excluding ignored build artifacts (default false).

parameters.name: extension
parameters.description: Case-insensitive extension, e.g. tex or .bib; omitted lists all kinds.

parameters.name: includeUntracked
parameters.description: Also list files created locally and not yet pushed to Overleaf, excluding ignored build artifacts (default false).

tool_signatures.name: list_history
tool_signatures.description: List the commits in a project

path.description: Only commits that changed this file or directory, relative to the project root. Omit for the whole project.

since.description: Only commits on or after this date, for example 2026-11-01 or 2 weeks ago.

until.description: Only commits on or before this date, in the same forms as since.

limit.description: Most commits to return, 1 to 200. Defaults to 20.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Most commits to return, 1 to 200. Defaults to 20.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Only commits that changed this file or directory, relative to the project root. Omit for the whole project.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only commits on or after this date, for example 2026-11-01 or 2 weeks ago.

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: Only commits on or before this date, in the same forms as since.

tool_signatures.name: list_projects
tool_signatures.description: List the Overleaf projects this server is configured to reach, marking which one is the default.

tool_signatures.name: list_sections
tool_signatures.description: List the sectioning commands in a .tex file, \\part down to \\subparagraph including starred forms, with their nesting depth and line ranges.

path.description: Path to the .tex file relative to the project root, e.g. main.tex.

followIncludes.description: Follow \\input, \\include, \\subfile and \\import from path, giving the outline of the whole document (default false).

parameters.name: followIncludes
parameters.description: Follow \\input, \\include, \\subfile and \\import from path, giving the outline of the whole document (default false).

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path to the .tex file relative to the project root, e.g. main.tex.

tool_signatures.name: list_tracked_changes
tool_signatures.description: Read the tracked changes and review-panel comment anchors on a document, as Overleaf

tool_signatures.name: move_file
tool_signatures.description: Move or rename a file inside one project, creating any missing parent directories.

fromPath.description: Current path of the file, relative to the project root, e.g. intro.tex.

toPath.description: New path for the file, relative to the project root, e.g. sections/intro.tex. Must stay inside the project and must not already exist.

parameters.name: fromPath
parameters.description: Current path of the file, relative to the project root, e.g. intro.tex.

parameters.name: toPath
parameters.description: New path for the file, relative to the project root, e.g. sections/intro.tex. Must stay inside the project and must not already exist.

tool_signatures.name: project_status
tool_signatures.description: Report where one project

tool_signatures.name: project_summary
tool_signatures.description: Summarize one project in a single structured result (file counts by kind, the likely main document and its section count, pending local work) to orient at the start of a task.

tool_signatures.name: push_changes
tool_signatures.description: Publish every pending local edit to Overleaf as one commit. This is the only tool that changes the project collaborators see, and the change is immediate and public.

tool_signatures.name: read_file
tool_signatures.description: Read one text file from the project after pulling the latest commits from Overleaf.

tool_signatures.name: read_section
tool_signatures.description: Read one section of a .tex file by its title: from its heading to the next heading at the same or a shallower level, stopping before trailing matter such as \\appendix, the bibliography or \\end{document}.

path.description: Path to the .tex file relative to the project root, e.g. main.tex.

sectionTitle.description: Section title exactly as it appears inside the sectioning command, e.g. Introduction for \\section{Introduction}. Call list_sections first if unsure.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path to the .tex file relative to the project root, e.g. main.tex.

parameters.name: sectionTitle
parameters.description: Section title exactly as it appears inside the sectioning command, e.g. Introduction for \\section{Introduction}. Call list_sections first if unsure.

tool_signatures.name: reject_tracked_changes
tool_signatures.description: Reject suggestions in a document: a suggested insertion is removed and a suggested deletion puts the original text back.

tool_signatures.name: replace_text
tool_signatures.description: Replace an exact snippet of text in a project file. Prefer it over write_file and edit_section for a targeted change: nothing outside the snippet is touched.

path.description: Path relative to the project root.

findText.description: Exact text to find, matched literally including whitespace and newlines. Not a regular expression.

replaceWith.description: Text to put in its place. Empty string deletes the snippet.

replaceAll.description: Replace every occurrence instead of requiring exactly one match (default false). Only set this when replacing all of them is intended.

parameters.name: findText
parameters.description: Exact text to find, matched literally including whitespace and newlines. Not a regular expression.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path relative to the project root.

parameters.name: replaceAll
parameters.description: Replace every occurrence instead of requiring exactly one match (default false). Only set this when replacing all of them is intended.

parameters.name: replaceWith
parameters.description: Text to put in its place. Empty string deletes the snippet.

tool_signatures.name: reply_to_comment
tool_signatures.description: Add a message to an existing review-panel comment thread, under your account

message.description: The reply, as it should appear in the thread.

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: The reply, as it should appear in the thread.

tool_signatures.name: resolve_comment
tool_signatures.description: Mark a review-panel comment thread as resolved, or reopen a resolved one with reopen: true.

reopen.description: Reopen a resolved thread instead of resolving an open one.

parameters.name: reopen
parameters.description: Reopen a resolved thread instead of resolving an open one.

tool_signatures.name: restore_file
tool_signatures.description: Put one file back to exactly what it was at an earlier revision, binary files included; a file deleted since then is brought back.

path.description: Path of the file to restore, relative to the project root, e.g. sections/intro.tex.

revision.description: Commit hash to restore the file from, as list_history prints it.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path of the file to restore, relative to the project root, e.g. sections/intro.tex.

parameters.name: revision
parameters.description: Commit hash to restore the file from, as list_history prints it.

tool_signatures.name: search_project
tool_signatures.description: Search the project

query.description: What to look for. Literal text by default, so LaTeX backslashes need no escaping; a regular expression when isRegularExpression is true.

isRegularExpression.description: Treat query as a regular expression instead of literal text (default false).

maximumMatches.description: Stop after this many matches, between 1 and 500 (default 100).

parameters.name: isRegularExpression
parameters.description: Treat query as a regular expression instead of literal text (default false).

parameters.name: maximumMatches
parameters.description: Stop after this many matches, between 1 and 500 (default 100).

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: What to look for. Literal text by default, so LaTeX backslashes need no escaping; a regular expression when isRegularExpression is true.

tool_signatures.name: show_diff
tool_signatures.description: Without revisions: a unified diff of everything in one project

fromRevision.description: Compare history from this commit hash instead of showing pending local changes.

path.description: Only this file or directory, relative to the project root. Omit for the whole project.

parameters.name: fromRevision
parameters.description: Compare history from this commit hash instead of showing pending local changes.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Only this file or directory, relative to the project root. Omit for the whole project.

tool_signatures.name: suggest_edit
tool_signatures.description: Replace an exact snippet of text so that it arrives in Overleaf as a tracked change a co-author can accept or reject, rather than as finished text.

findText.description: Exact text to replace, matched literally including whitespace. Must occur exactly once in the document.

replaceWith.description: Suggested replacement text. Empty string suggests deleting findText and nothing more.

parameters.name: findText
parameters.description: Exact text to replace, matched literally including whitespace. Must occur exactly once in the document.

parameters.name: replaceWith
parameters.description: Suggested replacement text. Empty string suggests deleting findText and nothing more.

tool_signatures.name: sync_project
tool_signatures.description: Pull the latest commits from Overleaf into one project

tool_signatures.name: upload_file
tool_signatures.description: Add a file to the project byte for byte, such as a figure, a PDF, a data file or a .bib from elsewhere: copied from a path on this computer, or decoded from base64. write_file is for text written in the call itself.

path.description: Where the file goes in the project, relative to the project root, e.g. figures/plot.png.

sourcePath.description: Absolute path of the file on this computer to copy, e.g. /Users/me/results/plot.png.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Where the file goes in the project, relative to the project root, e.g. figures/plot.png.

parameters.name: sourcePath
parameters.description: Absolute path of the file on this computer to copy, e.g. /Users/me/results/plot.png.

tool_signatures.name: verify_citations
tool_signatures.description: Look up the bibliography entries a document cites, to catch references that point at the wrong work or at nothing, such as a mistyped DOI or a citation made up by a model.

keys.description: Citation keys to look up, cited or not. Omit to look up the cited entries in citation order.

maximumEntries.description: Look up at most this many entries, between 1 and 100 (default ${DEFAULT_MAXIMUM_ENTRIES}); the reply says how many were left.

parameters.name: keys
parameters.description: Citation keys to look up, cited or not. Omit to look up the cited entries in citation order.

parameters.name: maximumEntries
parameters.description: Look up at most this many entries, between 1 and 100 (default ${DEFAULT_MAXIMUM_ENTRIES}); the reply says how many were left.

tool_signatures.name: write_file
tool_signatures.description: Write a whole file: create it, with any missing parent directories, or overwrite it entirely.

path.description: Path relative to the project root, e.g. sections/related-work.tex. Must stay inside the project.

content.description: The complete new contents of the file, not a fragment to append.

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: The complete new contents of the file, not a fragment to append.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path relative to the project root, e.g. sections/related-work.tex. Must stay inside the project.
